name: beehyv
tagline: Maps about 100,000 arXiv papers by meaning and finds empty regions that point to research gaps.
problem: AI research is expanding quickly with shallow and hard-to-replicate work, the team says.
solution: Clusters paper embeddings, projects them to a 2D map, finds voids with Voronoi diagrams and alpha shapes, and sends a local agent swarm to propose cross-pollinated ideas for a selected gap.
demo_moment: Team-described: select a void on the semantic map and see neighbouring work combined into a proposal.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Uses geometry, not an LLM's guess, to locate gaps.

lessons: A clear computational idea (empty space on a map) beats another chat interface.
